what: Full official-val reproduction of the released PSALM checkpoint (EnmingZhang/PSALM) under PSALM's own per-reference evaluation protocol, plus a per-expression cross-protocol run. Values are measured, not published rows.
env: glod-ris conda env (Python 3.10, torch 2.2.1+cu121, transformers 4.49); detectron2 inference shims exp/psalm_stubs for missing detectron2 surfaces; stanza not used
protocol_primary: PSALM released psalm/eval/referring_segmentation.py; one entry per REFER reference, all sentences of a reference concatenated in the prompt; mIoU = mean per-entry IoU (giou), oIoU = pooled IoU (ciou); n = 3811/3805/2573
protocol_crosscheck: same model/checkpoint evaluated with one entry per expression (10,834/10,758/4,896); reported separately because it is not the protocol PSALM's published rows use
published_row_note: PSALM's paper Table 8 reports RefCOCO/+/g cIoU 83.6/72.9/73.8 for a model trained with RefCOCO data (Segmentation Data C, RC, CI). The released checkpoint measured here does not reach that row; the gap is recorded as a reproduction/checkpoint-provenance gap, not as a verdict on the original work. All comparisons in the paper continue to quote the published rows as published.
